title: Supersaturation thresholds for expanded color-critical graphs
summary: For a $k$-uniform hypergraph $L$, let $h_L(n,q)$ be the minimum number of copies of $L$ in an $n$-vertex $k$-graph with $\mathrm{ex}(n,L)+q$ edges. Let $t_L(n,q)$ be the minimum number of copies obtained by adding $q$ edges to an extremal $L$-free $k$-graph. A graph is color-critical if deleting a suitable edge decreases its chromatic number. Let $\mathcal K_k(F)$ be the expanded graph obtained by adding $k-2$ new vertices to each edge of $F$, with disjoint sets of new vertices for distinct edges.
